profile.name: MatchBox紧凑型激光器
profile.description: 一种紧凑型激光模块，用于为实验中的光学激发、荧光照明、对准和一般激光光源需求提供稳定输出。常见于显微成像、光学实验和仪器集成场景。
profile.description_en: A compact laser module used to provide stable optical excitation for fluorescence illumination, alignment, and general laser source needs in laboratory setups. It is commonly used in microscopy, optical experiments, and instrument integration.
